{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Side dishes | Side dishes]] | [[Cookbook:East Asian cuisines| Asian Cuisine]]

This '''chicken salad''' is inspired by east and southeast Asian-associated flavors of soy, ginger, sesame, and mango.

== Ingredients ==
*1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:broccoli|broccoli]] flowerets
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Snow Pea|pea pods]]
*6 cups torn mixed greens 
*2 cups thinly-[[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] [[Cookbook:Nappa Cabbage|Nappa cabbage]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Julienne|julienned]] [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]]
*1 package (6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) grilled [[Cookbook:chicken|chicken]] breast, cut in strips
*¾ cups salad dressing (teriyaki [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]], Asian sesame with ginger, or balsamic vinaigrette)
*1 [[Cookbook:mango|mango]], peeled, seeded, and thinly sliced (optional)
*Sesame crackers (optional)

== Procedure ==
# In large [[cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]] quickly plunge broccoli and pea pods into boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain vegetables. Quickly rinse with cold water. Drain well.
# In large bowl toss together the [[Cookbook:Blanching|blanched]] broccoli and pea pods, greens, cabbage and carrots. 
# Add chicken. 
# Drizzle with salad dressing. Toss to coat. 
# Arrange on 4 serving plates. 
# Top with mango, if desired.
# Serve with crackers.
